digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge reconciler and ticket store
propositions: Multiple tracker projects against one codebase cannot use the bridge today because project is hard-wired at three points: JiraConfig.project scalar, fetcher JQL pair, and applier cross-project guard
Store must own the project set via .bridge_state/projects.json mapping to prevent each repo's fetch from misinterpreting other projects' tickets as remote deletions
Ticket project field must be tri-state (absent=legacy, empty=never sync, explicit=sync there) and resolve absent values to store's recorded legacy default with zero events written
Multi-project inbound fetch must iterate the configured project set once per project for base JQL and three enrichment passes, merging results into shared snapshot keyed by issue
Outbound mutations must check per-ticket project against configured project set and raise CrossProjectTargetError only for projects outside the set
Store carrying >1 project must bear multi-project-bridge in required_capabilities and fail-closed for older binaries lacking that capability, stamped atomically with mapping mutation in one commit
